# Lakeland Health Insurance
> Independent Lakeland, FL health insurance agency run by David Huff, licensed Florida health agent (FL #W371813, NPN 18213932). ACA Marketplace, Medicare (Florida only), and supplemental coverage reviews. Phone (863) 640-3102.
> We do not offer every plan available in your area. Currently we represent 8 organizations which offer 65 products in your area. Please contact Medicare.gov or 1-800-MEDICARE to get information on all of your options.
